crossRefs.note: “ ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:
Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle…
“Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

people.name: Zuar
people.line: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar

translations.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.
translations.bsb: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel son of Zuar.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
translations.asv: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Nethanel the son of Zuar.
